not_editable: This journal entry is posted and can no longer be edited or deleted.
already_posted: This journal entry is already posted.
not_posted: Only a posted journal entry can be reversed.
already_reversed: This journal entry has already been reversed.
line_needs_one_side: Each line must have either a debit or a credit amount, not both and not neither.
not_balanced: Total debits must equal total credits before posting.
account_inactive: One of the selected accounts is inactive.
